Maya (Growth): Quick sync: microlaunch posts + hero variants for tri-mode pages. Need 3 snackable posts, webinar teaser, and inbound routing logic. Thoughts?
Diego (PM): Timeline: webinar Tue 2024-04-12 10:00 PT. Publish posts day after. Landing updates by Mon EOD.
Olivia (Content): Drafted 3 hero lines for each mode — keeping concise, benefit-led.
Olivia (Content): ```
Hosted API: "Ship LLM features fast — pay-as-you-go, no infra." CTA: "Start hosted trial"
Dedicated: "Predictable throughput, reserved GPU capacity for production." CTA: "Request reserved capacity"
Private: "Keep models and data in your VPC or on-prem — enterprise controls." CTA: "Contact sales"
```
Sam (Design): @Olivia nice. Visual variants: line chart (cost vs latency), plus product screenshot. Will do 2 sizes for hero.
Maya (Growth): For social: need short teasers + webinar CTA. Aim for snackable: 1-liners + registration link.
Olivia (Content): Social drafts:
Olivia (Content): ```
1) "Latency that scales, cost that shrinks. Join our webinar to see Redwood's hosting modes in action -> <link>"
2) "Reserved GPUs, predictable SLAs. See Dedicated in our demo -> <link>"
3) "Private deployments for regulated workloads. Live Q&A at the webinar -> <link>"
``` 
Marcus (Ops): Routing note: forms should tag leads with `interest:hosted|dedicated|private` and list -> hosted_trial, reserved_capacity_inquiry, private_deployment_leads in HubSpot.
Diego (PM): Nurture sequences: Hosted = 3-day mini-edu drip; Dedicated = 5-day technical decision flow with benchmarks; Private = sales-assist + compliance playbook.
Maya (Growth): Benchmarks to track: webinar CTR -> 6% goal, landing CTA CTR -> 8%, form convert -> 12% on hosted, 6% on dedicated/private.
Sam (Design): I'll push hero comps to Figma by Fri noon. Need final copy by Thu 3pm.
Olivia (Content): I'll finalize copy variants A/B and share in doc. Quick ask: which Dedicated hero variant feels higher fidelity — A (throughput focus) or B (SLA + predictability)?
Maya (Growth): B feels clearer for enterprise audiences. A good for developer blog posts.
Diego (PM): Agreed. B for landing, A in blog/webinar demo slides.
Marcus (Ops): I'll set HubSpot forms and tags today. Ping me if field names change.
Maya (Growth): Great. Next steps: Olivia finalize copy by Thu 3pm, Sam deliver Figma by Fri noon, Marcus wire forms now, Diego orchestrates webinar timeline. :rocket:
webinar-bot: Reminder — webinar scheduled 2024-04-12 10:00 PT. Registration page: <link>
Maya (Growth): Thanks all. Quick follow-up: can we get two hero microtests running (Hosted vs Dedicated) for the hero CTA? Short run 48h after publish.
Diego (PM): Yep. I'll set experiment in the CMS. 
Olivia (Content): On it — will label variants `hero_A_hosted` / `hero_B_dedicated`.
Sam (Design): :thumbsup:
Marcus (Ops): Done: HubSpot lists and tags created.
Maya (Growth): Perfect — closing thread. We'll reconvene post-webinar for benchmark review. :tada:
